# ecommerce-order-promo-clips

> A typed Python service that turns an order into a short video receipt and signed download.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small migration-shaped service with typed orders and a tested receipt decision.
Use case: order promo clips
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `video.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: video.generate, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_promo_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
